use_case_name: Compare Two Files Byte by Byte

claims.content: To compare two files byte by byte to identify differences and check for corruption.

goal.raw_text: To compare two files byte by byte to identify differences and check for corruption.

claims.content: The user selects two files and initiates the byte-by-byte comparison function from the file management tools menu.

trigger.raw_text: The user selects two files and initiates the byte-by-byte comparison function from the file management tools menu.

claims.content: The user accesses the file management tools from the initial window of the application (file manager interface) or from the create archive window/create archive interface and extraction window/extraction interface.

The user selects the 'Byte to byte file comparison' function, which spots exactly what the different bytes are and is not susceptible to collisions under any circumstance, even if conditions are highly improbable and very difficult or not practically possible to trigger if a proper hash function is chosen.
The system performs the byte-by-byte comparison on the selected files.
The system displays the results of the comparison, highlighting the differences between the two files.
